title: How he joined and left Creath; back to Birmingham
summary: Creath asked him to stay on, he left after six months when the Birmingham theatre owner sent railroad fare.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: I see. How was it that you joined him? How did that come about?
Well, after I quit the show, Benbow's show, I joined Charlie Creath... Because I'm going to stay there for a while.
So in other words, you ran into him and he asked you to join, or you...?

He asked me to... I told him I was going to quit the show, leave the show, but I wanted to stay down...stay around for a while. He said, 'Well, what about working with me?' I said, 'Yeah.' He told me about the money; I think it was twenty-five dollars. I said, 'That's all right.' He said, 'Come by tomorrow.' I stayed there about six months.
Six months. Then you decided to leave Charlie Creath.

I was going back to Birmingham, Alabama. Went back to the theatre; I was playing a theatre there. That's the third time I left there and went back. I think it was very nice of the man... He sent me railroad fare to come back! During that time... I was getting twenty-seven dollars a week then.
What was the name of this gentleman who sent you the railroad fare?
H.J. Hewery(?). He owned the theatre.
Hewery(?). Would you happen to know how that's spelled?
